text:
maria_s: Heads-up: ops just flagged a region-wide latency spike. Need guidance on wording + timing for public status, enterprise email, and social embargo.

alex.k: Keep public status very short and non-technical. Hold social posts until we have a confirmed RCA or stable recovery. Enterprise email should go out only to impacted accounts and include support contact + mitigation steps.

liang_m: Ops ETA looks like ~90m to stable if the current failover finishes cleanly. If it extends >2h, recommend proactive credits offer.

tess_cs: I'll compile impacted customer list and hand to alex for segmentation. Also need translation for EU/JP customers — can we schedule fast localized copy?

translation-bot: We can turn around short localized alerts in 15-20m for Spanish, German, Japanese. Need final English copy.

marketing-bot: Draft short public status suggestion:
```
We are investigating elevated API latency in select regions. Our engineers are working on mitigation — performance should improve shortly. Updates within 30 minutes. If you are experiencing impact, contact support: https://redwood.ai/support
```

maria_s: Edits: remove "shortly" (vague), change to "expected updates in ~30 minutes", and add in-app opt-in: "Reply \"Priority\" to this thread for priority alerts." Keep credit language off public notice.

alex.k: Final public status (OK to publish now):
```
We are investigating elevated API latency in select regions. Mitigation is in progress; expected updates in ~30 minutes. If your app is impacted, contact support: https://redwood.ai/support (Reply "Priority" to this thread for priority alerts.)
```

liang_m: Publishing now would alert customers quickly — ops will post next technical update with RC/ETA. If ETA slips past 2h, we need to surface credits in enterprise follow-up.

tess_cs: For email we should: 1) acknowledge, 2) explain impact in plain terms, 3) list temporary mitigations (e.g., smaller batch sizes, retry window), 4) next steps and contact. Drafting now.

translation-bot: Ready to localize once English email approved. ETA for localized drafts 18m.

ops_bot: Status entry published by liang_m at 1969997872

maria_s: I pushed the in-app banner too :white_check_mark: Holding social and blog notices.

alex.k: Good. Action list: publish public status + banner (maria/liang) ✅, prepare segmented enterprise email but hold send (tess/alex) ⏳, translation pipeline ready (translation-bot) ✅, ops to update RC/ETA in 20m (liang).

tess_cs: Email subject suggestion: "Redwood Inference — service update affecting some regions". Will ping CS leads once draft is ready for review.

liang_m: I'll post a technical update in 20m with whether we hit the 90m timeline. If we exceed 2h, I'll flag for credits.

alex.k: Thanks team. Keep updates short and include impacted region names when we post technical notes. No external marketing channels until we have RCA or recovery.
